easyPrerequisites: For each listed card above that is in your graveyard, you must have three additional cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Wernog either from your hand, graveyard or from the command zone by paying {W}{B} plus commander tax or exiling three cards from your graveyard, if necessary.
When Wernog enters, it triggers, causing you to create at least one Food, one Clue and one Treasure.
When the artifact tokens enter, Grinding Station trigger that many times.
Resolve a Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by sacrificing a Clue or Food, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time. Then, resolve any remaining Grinding Station triggers, untapping it.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Metamorphosis either from your hand or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {G} and exiling three cards from your graveyard, if necessary, and sacrificing Wernog.
When Wernog dies, it triggers, causing you to create at least one Food, one Clue and one Treasure.
Repeat steps 3 through 6 once.
Resolve Metamorphosis, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W/B}.
Repeat from step 1.
